text: In April 2022 our record divides in two. Thirty of us said "the restaurant revitalization fund," first said by Suzanne Bonamici; twenty-eight said "relief for restaurants," first said by Marilyn Strickland; twenty-seven of us said "other hard hit small businesses act" and twenty-seven said "the relief for restaurants," both first said that same day, April 7, by Ami Bera. On the same peak day, twenty-six of us said "ketanji brown jackson," first said by Al Green, and twenty-three said "judge ketanji brown." Twenty-three of us said "the supreme court." Twenty-three of us said "first black woman." Two convergences, one day: a fund for restaurants, and a confirmation. We recorded both in nearly the same breath, and the count shows how many of us reached for the same words at once.
